file_id: Sultana Bibi & Anr vs Unknown on 12 July, 2024

sentences.text: Sultana Bibi & Anr vs Unknown on 12 July, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 39
12-07-2024
Ct. No.34 b.das Crr No. 2399 of 2024 In the matter of : Sultana Bibi & Anr.
..... petitioners.
Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee Ms. Salma Sultana Shah ...for the petitioners.

Mr. Debasish Roy Mr.
Bibaswan Bhattacharya Mr. Sachit Talukdar ...for the State.

Md. Wasim Akram Mr. Hamidul Hoque
Ms. Rashmi Khatun ...for the opposite party.
Supplementary affidavit submitted on behalf of the petitioners is taken on record.

The petitioners seek quashing of proceeding of GR Case No.1592 of 2024 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Malda on the ground that they have been falsely implicated due to strained relationship which developed between the parties subsequently.
No prima facie material under Section 420/406 of the Indian Penal Code has been made out against them.
The matter needs to be heard on merits.

The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application and supplementary affidavit along with all annexure thereto upon the private opposite party and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Learned counsel for the State submits that he has received the copy of the application as well as supplementary affidavit.
This order shall not preclude the investigating officer of the case from proceeding with the investigation.
No coercive steps be taken against the petitioners in connection with the present case till disposal of the application subject to the petitioners cooperating in the investigation.
Learned counsel for the private opposite party seeks to use an affidavit-in-opposition in this matter.
Affidavit- in-opposition be filed within three weeks from date.
Affidavit-in-reply, if any, be filed within a week thereafter.
Let the matter go out of the list for the time being.

Urgent certified website copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of requisite formalities.
